history.paragraph1: Founded in 2025, BankAvenir was born from a simple observation: traditional banks no longer meet the needs of modern users.

history.paragraph3: Today, over 500,000 customers trust us to manage their daily finances.

faqs.question: How do I open an account?
faqs.answer: Account opening takes less than 5 minutes from our app or website. You just need to provide a valid ID and proof of address.

faqs.question: What are the fees?
faqs.answer: Account opening and maintenance are completely free. SEPA transfers and bank cards are also included at no cost.

faqs.question: How do I contact support?
